body.name: Smooth nonzero-effect separable torus witness
body.construction: Take \(U\sim\operatorname{Unif}(\mathbb T^2)\), \(h_0^{\mathrm{sep}}(u)=u\), \(h_1^{\mathrm{sep}}(u)=(u_1+0.1\sin(2\pi u_1)/\pi,u_2)\), \(h_{1\star}^{\mathrm{sep}}(u)=(u_1+0.15\sin(2\pi u_1)/\pi,u_2-0.05\sin(2\pi u_2)/\pi)\), and let \(P^{\mathrm{sep}}\) be the four induced laws.
